name: @taffyjs/node
description: Native Node-API bindings for the Taffy layout engine.

scripts.build: napi build --manifest-path ../../crates/taffyjs_binding/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --js binding.js --dts binding.d.ts --esm --release -- --locked && vp fmt binding.js binding.d.ts package.json && node ../../tools/sync-platform-artifact.mjs && vp pack
scripts.build:debug: napi build --manifest-path ../../crates/taffyjs_binding/Cargo.toml --package-json-path package.json --output-dir . --platform --js binding.js --dts binding.d.ts --esm -- --locked && vp fmt binding.js binding.d.ts package.json && node ../../tools/sync-platform-artifact.mjs && vp pack
